font.label: Font

canvas.label: Text position. Click a line to select it, add lines with Ctrl or Shift; drag or use the arrow keys to move, 10 times with Shift. Double-click or Enter edits the text. Ctrl + wheel zooms, Space + drag pans.

check.ok: The text is inside the cut and doesn't touch the decoration.

text.pickLine: To edit the text, select a single line or double-click it.

text.empty: A line can't be empty; change the text instead of deleting it.

position.heading: Position
position.xHint: Plus moves right, minus left (design pixels)
position.yHint: Plus moves down, minus up (design pixels)

quick.canvas: Text position. Click a line to select it, drag to move it; arrow keys move it too. Double-click edits the text.
quick.hint: Drag a line to move it
quick.failed: The change could not be saved.

window.title: Detailed edit
